OFFICE MANAGER
Crossbay Pty Ltd T/A Drive Ready Australia
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Salary: $79,423 plus Superannuation 
About Us
Drive Ready Australia is a growing vehicle rental and automotive services company based in Perth. We manage a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and are committed to delivering reliable rental solutions and outstanding customer service. We are seeking an experienced and organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Managing the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the business. 
•	Coordinating communication between customers, workshop staff, suppliers and management. 
•	Managing financial administration, including rental payments, driver payments, bank reconciliations, outstanding accounts, payment plans and daily financial reporting. 
•	Administering end-to-end motor vehicle insurance claims, including preparing documentation, liaising with insurers and monitoring claims until completion. 
•	Coordinating fleet administration for more than 200 vehicles, including maintenance scheduling, repairs, onboarding and offboarding, GPS installations and vehicle availability. 
•	Preparing repair quotations, sourcing vehicle parts, liaising with suppliers and panel beaters, and supporting workshop operations. 
•	Preparing operational, financial, fleet and insurance reports for management. 
•	Supervising office administration, allocating tasks, assisting with staff onboarding and providing administrative support to employees. 
•	Preparing rental agreements, maintaining electronic records and ensuring accurate business documentation. 
•	Building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, insurers and business partners while resolving enquiries professionally. 
•	Identifying opportunities to improve office procedures and administrative efficiency. 
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
•	At least an AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Administration or a related field; or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	Demonstrated experience in office management or business administration. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
•	Experience in financial administration, including reconciliations and reporting. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and business management software. 
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Desirable
•	Experience in the motor vehicle, transport, fleet management or automotive industry. 
•	Experience dealing with insurance claims and vehicle fleet administration. 
•	Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero. 
Benefits
•	Competitive salary package. 
•	Stable full-time employment. 
•	Supportive and friendly working environment. 
•	Opportunities for career growth and professional development. 
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Location: Gold Coast Pacific Fair – Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, 2–30 Hooker Boulevard, Broadbeach QLD 4218?
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time?
Hours: 38 hours per week?
Salary: AUD $85,000–$90,000 per annum, plus superannuation

This advertisement is posted by Comandini Migration Services on behalf of Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd.

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.
* Ensure employees have a strong understanding of the brand, products and services.
* Monitor the store’s product assortment and provide feedback to Area Management and the Buying Team regarding customer and market demand.
* Oversee the overall presentation of the store.
* Maintain high visual merchandising and product display standards in accordance with company guidelines.
* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.
* Build a positive and supportive workplace culture based on trust, professionalism and accountability.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training and performance development.
* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, workplace health and safety requirements and other applicable regulations.
* Use relevant retail, customer relationship management and point-of-sale systems.
* Ensure employees are appropriately trained in all operational and digital systems.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
* Relevant experience managing a retail store or comparable retail operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading, developing and motivating a retail team.
* Strong knowledge of retail sales, customer service and store operations.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage key performance indicators.
* Experience in stock management, visual merchandising and operational compliance.
* Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to build strong relationships with customers, employees and business stakeholders.
* Experience using point-of-sale, customer relationship management and other retail management systems.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.

Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Technosoft Australia

Date Posted: 28 July 2026

Position: Office Manager

Salary: $76,600 to $85,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-time

Location: Level 19, 180 Lonsdale Street, Melbourne VIC 3000

Experience required: Minimum 1 years experience in relevant roles

Position Overview:

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Office Manager who will ensure smooth office operations. The ideal candidate will manage administrative tasks, coordinate logistics, and maintain efficient office functions to facilitate project execution.

The candidate in mind will be expected to perform the following duties that include but are not limited to:

• Manage day-to-day office operations, including scheduling, correspondence, and communications.

• Organize and maintain office filing systems (electronic and hard copy).

• Support construction and IT projects by managing project documentation and assisting with permit applications.

• Monitor office supplies and inventory, placing orders as required.

• Assist in budget management and financial operations, including accounts payable and receivable.

• Support HR functions, including coordinating recruitment activities, onboarding new employees, and maintaining personnel records.

• Develop and implement office policies and procedures to enhance productivity.

• Coordinate and assist in preparing bids, tenders, and quotations for client projects.

• Manage emails and the calendar of the Company Director.

• Oversee courier shipments, ensuring accurate tracking of all incoming and outgoing packages.

• Schedule meetings, allocate tasks to office staff, and monitor their performance.

• Maintain proper office layout and organization, ensuring a professional environment.

• Keep accurate records of office expenses and financial documentation.

• Act as the primary point of contact for office-related duties and communicate effectively with internal departments.

• Maintain field staff timesheets and input data into the payroll system.

• Audit and manage technical team gear and tools, arranging purchases based on team requisitions.

• Coordinate travel logistics, including flight bookings, accommodation, and other necessary travel arrangements for project teams.

Qualifications:

• Tertiary qualification in Business Management or relevant (Preferred but not mandatory).

Skills and Experience:

• Proven experience as an Office Manager or in a similar administrative role.

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and office management software.

• Experience in budget management and financial operations.

• Understanding of HR processes, recruitment, and onboarding.

• Ability to manage logistics and coordinate travel arrangements.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

We welcome applications from suitably experienced candidates for this role. Interested applicants are invited to submit their resume and supporting documents via email recruit@gvrc.com.au for consideration.

Target Business Services
Location: 9 Limbee Gld, Huntingdale, WA 6110
Salary: $80,000 Plus 12% Superannuation
Position: Full Time, Permanent

Our client, Khosa Concrete & Landscaping Pty Ltd, located in Huntingdale, Western Australia, is a growing construction business specialising in high-quality concreting, landscaping and outdoor construction solutions throughout the Perth metropolitan area. The company delivers a broad range of residential and commercial projects, including concrete driveways, pathways, patios, retaining walls, paving, fencing, timber structures, artificial turf installations and complete landscape transformations. 

Due to continued business growth and an increasing volume of construction projects, our client is seeking an experienced and motivated Carpenter to join its skilled construction team. The successful applicant will undertake a variety of carpentry works associated with building interiors, outdoor living spaces and structural construction, while ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

-	Read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications to determine materials, dimensions and installation requirements. 
-	Measure, cut, shape, assemble and install timber, plywood and other building materials to required specifications. 
-	Construct, install and repair timber frameworks, wall frames, floor systems, roof structures, partitions and ceilings. 
-	Install doors, windows, skirting boards, architraves, staircases, cabinetry and other interior and exterior timber fittings. 
-	Build and install pergolas, decking, fencing, gates and other outdoor timber structures. 
-	Carry out first-fix and second-fix carpentry works for residential and commercial building projects. 
-	Undertake formwork construction where required to support building and landscaping projects. 
-	Repair and maintain existing timber structures, fixtures and fittings to ensure structural integrity and appearance. 
-	Operate, maintain and inspect carpentry tools, machinery and equipment in a safe and efficient manner. 
-	Estimate material requirements and assist in ordering timber and construction materials. 
-	Ensure all carpentry works comply with Australian building codes, project specifications and workplace health and safety requirements. 
-	Liaise professionally with clients, supervisors and other trades to ensure projects are completed on time and to a high standard.

Skills & Qualifications

-	AQF Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent trade qualification), including at least two years of structured on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV in a relevant trade.
-	Minimum one year of relevant full-time experience as a Carpenter.
-	Ability to accurately read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
-	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building materials and safe work practices.
-	High attention to detail with excellent workmanship and problem-solving abilities.
-	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
-	Good organisational and time management skills with the ability to meet project deadlines.
-	Sound understanding of Australian Workplace Health and Safety requirements.

Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.
To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au

Position Summary:

The role of Office Manager is responsible for the full operation of office management activities at our company.
The incumbent in the role is expected to operate at a consistently high standard ensuring core administrative systems and relevant personnel are operating effectively and efficiently to adequately meet the needs of our growing business.

Scope of the role:

The scope of this role is broad, encompassing the full scope of activities required to support the smooth running of our office environment.

Main Duties:

- Coordinate and oversee administrative processes relating to tour bookings, accommodation reservations, customer enquiries and day-to-day office operations to ensure efficient service delivery.

- Maintain and manage customer records, booking systems, financial documentation, correspondence and other business administration records.
- Liaise with customers, suppliers, accommodation providers, contractors and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth business operations and resolve administrative matters.

- Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company policies, tourism industry obligations and relevant legislative and regulatory requirements; while coordinating recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration and staff record management activities.

Title:  Performance Planning Manager (Mobile Apps)
Trading Under: Publicis Media
Location: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Role Review:
As Performance Planning Manager (Mobile Apps), you will sit at the intersection client service and elevating mobile planning from an execution led capability to a strategic, future facing planning pillar, tightly connected to your client’s broader audience, measurement, and activation ecosystem. 
This role is central to building a scalable, high performing mobile planning model, bringing greater consistency across markets while empowering teams through clear frameworks, shared standards, and accountability. You’ll have the autonomy to shape standards, influence conversations, and build a scalable approach that will be felt across markets.
You will lead mobile app planning and performance oversight for your client, supporting the development and delivery of mobile first strategies aligned to client objectives. Acting as a day to day planning and client service partner, you will contribute clear thinking on mobile strategy, audience approach, measurement, and investment trade offs and shape mobile planning frameworks, helping bring consistency and clarity across markets while allowing for local execution. 
With your excellent knowledge of iOS and Android ecosystems, including app store dynamics, platform constraints, and the impact of privacy and policy changes on planning, you will lead conversations on mobile strategy, audience approach, measurement, and investment trade offs. 
Essential requirements - This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu for qualification
